A.rationale: the acid burden of an uncontrolled haemorrhage drives the rate; how high RR is at 120 min depends on the burden's production and clearance (B, tau), the frequency gain and the intrinsic RR
A.title: untreated 57m RR at 120 (R1)

B.rationale: as A for the smaller arrival burden and deficit of 72f; an early dip is possible when clearance exceeds production
B.title: untreated 72f RR at 120 (R1)

C.rationale: compensatory hyperventilation by recruitment (common ventilation gain) lowers PaCO2 as the burden rises; pH follows HCO3 and PaCO2
C.title: untreated 57m PaCO2 / pH at 120 (R1)

E.rationale: crystalloid restores preload and delivery for a while; the deficit falls, production with it, and RR follows the burden
E.title: RR response to crystalloid (R2: RR120 - RR0)

F.rationale: red cells restore oxygen content; without haemostasis the deficit can return
F.title: RR response to PRBC without haemostasis (R3: RR120 - RR0)

G.rationale: with haemostasis and resuscitation the deficit ends and the burden clears over tau; RR descends toward the intrinsic RR
G.title: RR at 120 after definitive management (R4)

H.rationale: as the burden clears, recruitment fades and PaCO2 returns toward 40 while HCO3 recovers
H.title: PaCO2 / pH at 120 after definitive management (R4)

I.rationale: the RR share still driven by the uncleared burden
I.title: residual RR above intrinsic at 120 after adequate resuscitation (R4)

demand.path: demand -> effective deficit -> acid burden -> drive (RR) and recruitment (W) -> PaCO2 / pH; the baseline-relative W reads no demand class directly

hr_latent.proof: HR reaches no output, delivery, deficit, D, lactate or burden (P2I-2AG, P2J-1)

map_set.proof: P2J-4 rows_equal: the baroreflex moves only the sympathetic drive; no deficit, burden, RR or W term reads it

tone_gain.path: g -> T -> output -> delivery -> deficit -> acid burden

design.candidate_rule: Predeclared before any count. RR side: P2K-2's frozen supports (intrinsic RR 12 / 16 / 20 per patient, drive gain 1 to 4 at ratio sqrt 2, common), S = 25. Acid side: B 13.4 / 19.4 / 28 x tau 60 / 120 / 240 (P2K-2), never forced to rise. Ventilation side: the faculty's common gain 0.03 / 0.04 / 0.05 / 0.06 / 0.08 per mEq/L, efficiency 1, PaCO2 reference 40, the baseline-relative demand. Arrival: RR within +/- 3 of the authored RR (P2K-2's analytic test), then the predicted PaCO2 40 / (1 + gain x A0) within the faculty's window per case; pH diagnostic only. Factorized: the burden per (B, tau) and deficit trajectory, RR per (drive gain, intrinsic RR), W / PaCO2 / pH per ventilation gain; no product of dimensions an output does not read.

faculty.acid: the untreated burden is not forced to rise (production and clearance coexist; it may fall when clearance exceeds production); B 13.4 / 19.4 / 28 and tau 60 / 120 / 240 kept, none approved, no extension
faculty.arrival_paco2: 57m 31, 72f 33 at +/- 3 mmHg (ARRIVAL_PACO2_TOLERANCE_PROVISIONAL): 28-34 and 30-36; one common ventilation gain; zero common survivors is a stop, never a wider tolerance
faculty.arrival_ph: 57m 7.37, 72f 7.40; pH derived from HCO3 and PaCO2, never tuned; +/- 0.03 diagnostic only (PH_CONSISTENT / PH_INCONSISTENT), never a filter (it would count the same HCO3 / PaCO2 twice)
faculty.arrival_rr: 57m 26 +/- 3, 72f 24 +/- 3; patient-specific intrinsic RR, common drive gain, no residual offset
faculty.closed: P2K-2 accepted and closed: the acid burden explicit and independent of lactate and D, lactate -> RR retired in the candidate, no D -> RR, an explicit drive, PaCO2 and pH causal, RR and W distinguishable; numeric RR calibration NOT authorized
faculty.decision_pack: LOW / median / HIGH for nine observables, prepared, never approved; no late hard filter
faculty.efficiency: 1 for the GI cases as a STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE; no clinical efficiency grid; below 1 only in synthetic probes; not a universal constant (future mechanics, dead space or fatigue families may replace it)
faculty.issue: FREQUENCY_TO_VENTILATION_OVERCONSTRAINT: W proportional to RR / intrinsic RR made a low intrinsic RR (12-16) imply a resting PaCO2 up to about 74 mmHg once the burden resolved; intrinsic RR 12 and 16 are not removed to hide it

faculty.references: HCO3_reference 24 and PaCO2_reference 40 COMMON_REFERENCE_PROVISIONAL; arrival RR +/- 3 ARRIVAL_RR_TOLERANCE_PROVISIONAL; none FACULTY_APPROVED; unchanged after outcomes
faculty.rr: P2K-2's RR structure kept: intrinsic RR 12 / 16 / 20 per patient, the frozen drive-gain support, S = 25 semantics; no range changed
faculty.scope: shadow only: no runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, final RR / acid / ventilation-gain approval, hard respiratory envelope, consciousness recalibration, collapse activation, mechanical ventilation or legacy fitting
faculty.shared_driver: the acid burden drives RR (frequency) and, independently, effective ventilation recruitment (W): two responses to one driver, never an identity; RR must not determine W

future.fatigue: a fatigue state would cap or erode the recruitment over time
future.hypoxaemic_drive: HYPOXEMIC_DRIVE_DEFERRED (P2K-2); a term would add to the drive
future.mechanics: a mechanics family would lower ventilation_efficiency (compliance, resistance, dead space)
future.override: a mechanical ventilator would set the capacity (and RR) directly, bypassing the drive
future.status: FUTURE_RESPIRATORY_GENERALIZATION: none of these is a GI blocker; the recruitment mapping is the minimal abstraction for spontaneously breathing GI patients
future.tidal_volume: an explicit tidal-volume / dead-space state would replace the recruitment term (capacity = minute ventilation x (1 - dead-space fraction) over the baseline)

design.identifiability_rule: Frozen. The arrival RR and PaCO2 (+/- 3, provisional) are the only authored respiratory constraints; pH is derived from them. A latent parameter is WELL_CONSTRAINED when one value survives jointly, PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED when some but not all do, POORLY_IDENTIFIED when every value survives in some joint combination although the arrival reads it (a trade-off with another parameter), NON_IDENTIFIABLE when the arrival does not read it (B, tau: no authored observation after arrival). A composite is WELL_CONSTRAINED when its spread over the joint survivors is at most its tolerance half-width (RR 3, PaCO2 3, pH 0.03; the recruitment through the PaCO2 it implies), PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED when at most the full window, POORLY_IDENTIFIED above, NON_IDENTIFIABLE without survivors. No best set.
design.policy: Shadow only. The P2K-3 candidate is the P2K-2 acid-base profile plus a ventilation gain read by clinical_core.ventilation, which no core step reads; the core files are unchanged. Supports predeclared and exploratory; nothing selected or approved; no envelope filters any trajectory (ANALYTIC_REJECTION and SIMULATION_REJECTION mark only impossible values); pH never filters; the legacy RR is never read.
design.probe_rule: Synthetic, structural only: P2K-2's neutral probe arrival (no deficit; HCO3 20, so A0 = 4; intrinsic RR 16) and probe profile (drive gain 2, B 19.4, tau 120, efficiency 1), ventilation gain 0.05. A: burden 4 -> 8. B: RR alone (drive gain 2 -> 4, and S 25 -> 15) at burden 8. C: intrinsic RR 12 / 16 / 20 at burden 8. D: ventilation gain 0.03 -> 0.08 at burden 8. E: lactate alone. F: D alone. G: efficiency 0.5 with a high RR (drive gain 4, burden 8), and a 20-minute course with efficiency 1 -> 0.5 while the burden rises 4 -> 10. H: burden 0 at the baseline demand, every intrinsic RR, drive gain and ventilation gain. I: demand ratio 1.25 at burden 8, and the burden whose recruitment compensates it. W channel: state W +/- 0.5. Not candidates, not clinical values.
design.reconstruction_rule: The P2J-3 region recomputed with P2J-3's own functions and the deficit, D and lactate of every unique (scenario, blood set, lactate-side point) rebuilt as P2K-1 / P2K-2 did (acid_base.reconstruct). The burden per (B, tau) is the core's acid_burden_after_minute (acid_base.burden_series); RR is the core's algebra per (drive gain, intrinsic RR); W, PaCO2 and pH the ventilation module's algebra per ventilation gain at efficiency 1 and the baseline demand. Each observable is read over the factors it depends on only (RR never multiplied by the ventilation gain, W never by the drive gain or intrinsic RR). Validated against full core runs with the candidate declared (every upstream row equal to the run without it).

semantics.burden: P2K-2 unchanged: A' = A + (B / tau) x effective deficit - A / tau, never forced to rise
semantics.candidate: the P2K-2 profile with its three gains declared, plus ventilation.VentilationCandidate(gain); the core's step, derive and arrival state never read it, so no core file changes
semantics.capacity: ventilation.ventilatory_capacity = efficiency x (1 + acid_to_ventilation_gain x A): the implicit tidal-volume / effective-ventilation recruitment by the acid burden; no tidal-volume state
semantics.demand: BASELINE_RELATIVE: the metabolic demand is the minute's oxygen demand over the patient's baseline demand (which carries the 1.0 / 1.1 demand class), as in P2K-2: W = 1 is the ventilation of the patient's own baseline CO2 production, so the demand class reaches W only through the deficit and the burden. The absolute demand index is the alternative, reported analytically as a sensitivity (it would make the 1.1 class 10 % hypercapnic at rest), never used
semantics.efficiency: the profile's ventilation_efficiency, 1 in every clinical evaluation (structural reference)
semantics.frequency_drive: RR - intrinsic RR: the drive's share of the rate
semantics.old_mapping: P2K-2 (derived.alveolar_ventilation): W = efficiency x (RR / intrinsic RR) / (demand / baseline), PaCO2 = PaCO2_rest / W with PaCO2_rest anchored to the authored arrival PaCO2; kept in derived.respiration only to reproduce the closed P2K-2 record, SUPERSEDED in the P2K-3 candidate
semantics.paco2: PaCO2 = 40 / W (the profile's paco2_reference_mmhg): predicted at arrival, never anchored to the authored PaCO2, which only filters (+/- 3)
semantics.ph: pH = 6.1 + log10(HCO3 / (0.03 PaCO2)) (derived.carbonic_ph); HCO3 = arrival HCO3 - (A - A0) (P2K-2)
semantics.recruitment: 1 + acid_to_ventilation_gain x A: the ventilation side's response to the same burden
semantics.rr: P2K-2 unchanged: drive = acid_to_drive_gain x A, RR = intrinsic + S (1 - exp(-drive / S)), S = 25
semantics.w: ventilation.effective_ventilation = capacity / (aux.oxygen_demand / anchors.metabolic_demand_baseline); 0 without breathing (no pulse); no RR, intrinsic RR, drive gain, lactate, D or W-channel term

ventilation_status.demand: the oxygen demand over the patient's baseline demand (BASELINE_RELATIVE)
ventilation_status.paco2_reference_mmhg: COMMON_REFERENCE_PROVISIONAL (the profile's 40 mmHg); not approved. Here it is the PaCO2 at W = 1 (no burden, baseline demand, efficiency 1), not the arrival-PaCO2 fallback derived.arrival_paco2 gives it in P2K-2; the authored arrival PaCO2 only filters the arrival (+/- 3)
ventilation_status.tidal_volume: IMPLICIT: no tidal-volume, dead-space, mechanics or fatigue state
ventilation_status.ventilation_efficiency: STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE 1 for the GI cases; below 1 only in synthetic probes; not a universal constant

design.verdict_rule: Frozen. READY when every criterion holds: RR does not determine W (probes A, B, D, G, I and no pulse; the static proof that no assignment to a W-side name and no returned W-side field reads a rate, intrinsic RR or drive name; and the full-core recomputation with another drive gain); the intrinsic RR determines neither W nor the resting PaCO2 (probes C and H, question 1: 40 at every intrinsic RR, and the full-core recomputation with another intrinsic RR); lactate and D reach no RR or W term (probes E, F, the W channel); the arrival RR is reproduced (at least one RR-compatible candidate) and the arrival PaCO2 with one common ventilation gain (at least one joint candidate; none is a STOP); pH is coherent (derived by the bicarbonate relation: the formula probe, and the factorized pH equal to the core's in the validation; every value within the plausible 6.8-7.8; the bank's reconstruction within 0.005); the trajectories are patient-like (W > 0 and PaCO2 > 0 wherever breathing; in every R4 combination RR stays at least 1 breath/min above intrinsic 15 min after haemostasis, and the haemostasis minute moves RR and PaCO2 no more than another minute); the factorization is valid (the core equals it, order independent); the upstream is unchanged (rows and states equal, the P2J-3 region, P2K-1 and P2K-2 reproduced, the default RR, the core files at their P2K-2 hashes); nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion as the blocker; an early stop evaluates only the criteria it reached and lists the others as not evaluated. The acid burden is never required to rise.
